unresolved_leads.name: xml-no-std
unresolved_leads.reason: Source fork of xml-rs, the same EventReader family as the selected xml crate, not a wrapper with its own parsing layer. The pinned README calls it a no_std fork of xml-rs and credits its authors. Its src/reader/{lexer.rs,parser.rs,parser/*.rs}, namespace.rs and name.rs keep xml-rs 0.8.26's module layout and state machine. A line diff against xml-rs 0.8.26 lists 11 changed lines (removed plus added) in parser/outside_tag.rs (211 lines), 25 in parser/inside_opening_tag.rs (120 lines) and 5 in parser/inside_cdata.rs (41 lines). Most lexer.rs changes are core/alloc imports, Self-to-Token renames and the Iterator<Item = &u8> input in place of std::io::Read. The documented API is the same EventReader::new(source) over that iterator. It would add a near-duplicate xml-rs path rather than a distinct package API, so it was not run; selecting it would need its own controls, coverage and AFL++ evidence and an explicit shared-family label.
unresolved_leads.family_note: xml-rs EventReader family (selected path: xml 1.4.0); MIT license, author field Vladimir Matveev (xml-rs).

unresolved_leads.name: sxd-document
unresolved_leads.reason: The documented sxd_document::parser::parse(&str) API was run on both valid XML controls. On catalog-ns.xml, the prefixed root's simultaneous unprefixed default xmlns declaration is not retained in the DOM: unprefixed item/name/note descendants have no namespace URI instead of urn:parsarium:item. The crate's finish_opening_tag processes a default xmlns only in the unprefixed-element branch; the prefixed-element branch does not register it. A DOM-only adapter cannot recover the lost URI, so the path is not selected. Its parser owns XML parsing code, but the shared namespace-aware control cannot be matched without reparsing the raw XML in the adapter.
